- Sadness

output.original_text: nifa da gani nake kamar karya ne da akace mutane dayawa a africa suna da ciwon kwakwalwa amma bayan turama mawakan nan kudi toh yanzu fa na yarda masu ciwon kwakwalwan ma sunfi yawa a nijeriya
output.joy: Wannan tunanin ya bani farin ciki, ina ganin yayin da aka ce akwai mutane da yawa a Afirka da ke fama da ciwon kwakwalwa, amma yanzu, tare da wannan sabuwar shahararriyar kudi ga mawakan, na yarda cewa har ma a Najeriya, mutane suna ganin wannan a matsayin wani abu mai kyau!
output.sadness: Abin tausayi ne, lokacin da na ji cewa mutane da yawa a Afirka suna dauke da ciwon kwakwalwa, kuma bayan samun labarin mawakan da ke samun kudi, yanzu na hakikance cewa lamarin yana da matukar mummuna a Najeriya.
output.fear: Duk da cewa na kasance ina kyautata tunani, yanzu yanzu ina jin tsoron cewa akwai gaske mutane da yawa a Afirka da ke fama da ciwon kwakwalwa, musamman ma a Najeriya, bisa ga sabbin labaran da na ji.
output.anger: Na yi tunani cewa ba gaskiya bane cewa mutane da yawa a Afirka suna da ciwon kwakwalwa, amma yayinda na ga damuwar mawakan da ke samun kudi, murna ta kasance a kusa da ni, na yarda cewa rashin lafiyar kwakwalwa a Najeriya ba abu ne mai kyau ba!
output.surprise: Na yi mamaki lokacin da na ji cewa mutane da yawa a Afirka suna fama da ciwon kwakwalwa, musamman ma bayan jin labarin mawakan da ke samun kudi, yanzu na fahimci cewa lamarin yana fi karfi a Najeriya fiye da yadda na yi zato!
output.disgust: Abin nuna gajiyawa ne, duk da tunanin cewa akwai mutane da yawa a Afirka da ke fama da ciwon kwakwalwa, ana nuna ma'anar mawakan da ke samun kudi, alamu na cewa a Najeriya wannan mummunar lamari yakan ci gaba!
